title: A dark, flash-lit bedtime selfie with no bed in shot counts
origin: Spec #7 (photo and voice verification): Yanni's own example of plausible proof

history.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 9:45, selfie with the lights off.

plan.step: In bed with the phone down and lights off by 9:45 pm
plan.proof_note: selfie in bed with the lights off
plan.reason: Same time every night is what resets your sleep.

testerLines: [photo dark-selfie.jpg: a dark, flash-lit selfie of the tester squinting at the flash, shirt off, dark room; no bed visible in the shot] phone's going down 😴
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: plausible proof should count without interrogation.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH treats the dark, flash-lit selfie as plausible proof of bedtime (it fits, even though the bed isn't in the shot) and celebrates in one or two short sentences, counting night 3. It doesn't question the photo, ask for a better one, or describe anything that isn't in it.
